'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Jeffrey Johns LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Alliance Showdown
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
